note: Identity of this log as a C2SP transparency log (TLOG.md §4-5). The origin line is PERMANENT: it names the log for every witness and client forever; changing it creates a new log identity. The checkpoint key is distinct from every pulse-signing key; it asserts 'this is the log', never 'this host observed this'.
enabled_note: set true (and commit) only after the origin string is confirmed; the first signed checkpoint fixes the identity
site_note: notbefore.net serves this repository's root as static assets (wrangler.jsonc); /checkpoint and /checkpoints/* are text/plain, CORS-open. Clients cross-check the checkpoint served by the site against the one in git: two different heads under this key is a split between publication surfaces.
